name: guardrails
description: Boundaries, secret masking, a second opinion before irreversible commands, shell autocorrect, loop breaker, diff budget

boundaryPaths.title: Boundary paths
boundaryPaths.description: Regex over the session's folder that marks a fenced session (say, employer code). Empty turns the boundary off.

fencedTools.title: Tools blocked inside the boundary
fencedTools.description: Regex over tool names (mcp__server__tool) a fenced session may not call.

fencedHosts.title: Hosts blocked inside the boundary
fencedHosts.description: Regex over URLs and shell commands a fenced session may not reach.

insideOnlyTools.title: Tools allowed only inside the boundary
insideOnlyTools.description: Regex over tool names that only a fenced session may call (say, writes to a work memory).

maskSecrets.title: Mask secrets
maskSecrets.description: Mask keys, tokens and passwords in tool output before the model reads them.

secondOpinion.title: Second opinion
secondOpinion.description: Before an irreversible shell command, ask a forked model call whether the conversation approved it.

shellFixes.title: Shell autocorrect
shellFixes.description: Rewrite or stop shell commands known to fail (gh after cd or in pipes, timeout on macOS, zsh = words).

loopBreaker.title: Loop breaker
loopBreaker.description: Stop a command after 3 identical failures and an Edit that flips a file back and forth.

diffBudget.title: Diff budget
diffBudget.description: Changed lines before a warning; 0 sizes the budget per task with a quick Haiku call; -1 turns it off.
